ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 8.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black edge and scar pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous white field across the central surface of both lobes; low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; yellowish-tan pixel clusters concentrated at the inferior base (peduncle junction); isolated dark-gray mottling in the lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 65 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the visible vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, moderate-amplitude serration on the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits a more linear boundary with lower-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex curves fitted from the median notch to the distal tips, maintaining a smooth upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters detected on the lower-left lobe surface and adjacent to the central vertical axis.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of two distinct, dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) situated just below the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical dark scar extending from the median notch toward the base; irregular, jagged loss of fluke material on the upper-distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown surface staining located at the ventral base of the fluke lobes.
